reason: I already pay for a dispatch package with years of bookings, clients and vehicle history in it, and I'm not ripping that out for a brand-new outfit with zero customers. The double-booking last year hurt, but swapping systems mid-season is exactly how you get another one.
objection: Moving all my data and retraining drivers who aren't tech people, onto software from a company that might not be around in two years. If it falls over on a Saturday wedding run, who do I ring?
would_change_my_mind: They migrate all my existing data from my current system for free, run it alongside my old one for a couple of months at no charge, and I can talk to a few operators my size who've been on it for a while without problems.
